CO-ROUTINE sub
  SETUP
    SEARCH w USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_work_1 (id=?)
  RECURSIVE STEP
    SCAN sub
    SEARCH w USING INDEX work_children (parent_id=?)
SCAN sub
SEARCH vw USING COVERING INDEX media_version_work_work (work_id=?)
SEARCH f USING INDEX media_file_version (version_id=?)
SEARCH r USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_library_folder_1 (id=?)
SCALAR SUBQUERY 3
  SEARCH x USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_work_1 (id=?)
  SEARCH t USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_work_1 (id=?)
USE TEMP B-TREE FOR DISTINCT
USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY
